caseName: Delaware River Joint Toll Bridge Commission v. Colburn
caseNameFull: Delaware River Joint Toll Bridge Commission v. Colburn
attorneys: Mr. Edward P. Stout for petitioner. Mr. Egbert Rosecrans for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Errors and Appeals of New Jersey granted. The Court directs the attention of counsel to the question of the jurisdiction of this Court.
